cases.long_description: I went out to have a smoke and walk my dog when I caught something in the corner of my eye and watched it slowly get closer and I knew it didn't look right it was flying just above the trees about a mile away slowly getting closer and when it got close enough to comprehend what I was looking at I realized it was not anything I've could recognize not a plane it was rectangle in shape but had an odd shape like a big chunk of mangled metal and half cloaked with orangish yellow lights along the bottom side of it it looked like it was trying to half cloak itself but wasn't! And it moved slowly over my head. By that time, I yelled for my girlfriend to come look! I wasn't even thinking about taking a video or yelling for my phone because I couldn't believe what I was seeing! And she came out and watched it with me as it was just coming over our heads. It slowly moved across the sky, and slowly ascending into a cloud and we both waited to see if it came out of the cloud but never did! And then the next evening my girlfriend was walking the dog and there is a big fig tree in the middle of the yard, and she sees a small being looking around the tree/bush and it was grayish green in color with big black eyes long skinny arms. The dog started to freak out, so she grabbed her and ran into the house put a blanket over the kitchen windows so if incase it looking at us. She ran upstairs and told me and were uneasy for a long time until we finally fell asleep. I don't know if what we saw was alien or some kind of unknown government involved craft! But I believe my girlfriend when she says she see something hiding behind the bush! All I know is I've never experienced anything like that so close up! I've had ufo sightings in the past and after but nothing like that right in my face! I so wish I would have thought to tell my girlfriend to grab my phone, but I wasn't thinking about that I was just so unexpected and i was dumbfounding that I didn't think about it! I just want to get my story out there so that we may be able to figure out what's going on with all this thanks!
